newsitem.title: USA: ITT Hartford Q3 catastrophe claims tripled.
newsitem.headline: ITT Hartford Q3 catastrophe claims tripled.

text.p: ITT Hartford Group Inc said on Friday its catastrophe claims for 1996's third quarter were $49 million, more than triple the $14 million for the same period last year.

The company said in a statement that without $693 million in non-recurring after-tax charges it would have reported $150 million of net income for the quarter, a 13 percent decline from the same quarter last year.
The one-time charges include a $510 million increase in asbestos and environmental reserves.

Core earnings were $132 million, down 15 percent from the $155 million in the third quarter of 1995, "primarily due to unusually high catastrophe claims and the resolution of several large environmental cases," the statement said.

"Excluding these two items, core earnings were up 16 percent to $215 million from $186 million for the third quarter 1995. Catastrophe claims for the period were unusually high at $49 million, more than triple the $14 million reported for the same period last year."
